modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
Prompt: “The first Game Boy commercial 1989”

Kling 4.0 Flash (20s) vs Seedance 2.5 (30s) -raw outputs

Kling: Cozy living-room scene, two kids locked on Tetris while the sister watches, ends on the classic 
“Now you’re playing with power!” tag + product shot. Feels the most like an actual late-80s family ad.

Seedance: More cinematic montage 
glowing cartridge insert, park bench, intense bedroom close-up, city street, big product hero shot. 
Stronger lighting and drama, but the tagline becomes “It’s a whole new world.”

Both capture the chunky gray brick and green-screen Tetris energy. Both also completely melt the tiny text on the Game Boy (classic AI struggle).

Which one feels closer to the real 1989 vibe? 🎮
#AIVideo #GameBoy #KlingAI #Seedance @Kling_ai
